decision_record_2a.transfer: Liquidity demanders pay the quoted spread to immediacy providers; these sleeves were donating it back by crossing ask-on-entry / bid-on-exit with market orders on a 5-session recovery edge.
decision_record_2a.comparison: Paired shadow control on the same opportunity: control_price = package ask (entry) / package bid (exit) the pre-change market order would have crossed; treatment = limit at package mid.
decision_record_2a.mechanism: Execution / spread capture: replace market orders with a limit at the bid/ask mid of the already-fetched fresh quotes. Selection, sizing (still computed off the ask debit), gates, exits rules unchanged.
decision_record_2a.calculation: saved_per_package = control_price - treatment_mid (entry) or treatment_mid - control_price (exit), recorded per intent in enhance_exp.spread_saved; sleeve P&L uplift = sum over filled paired records minus any mid-limit non-fills.
decision_record_2a.experiment: Forward paper: paired records journaled (extra['aster_enh_exp_journal']) for every treated intent. Reject if mid-limit fill rate < 80% of control-window entries over 20 paired opportunities, or mean spread_saved <= 0. Switch OFF restores the pre-change market order exactly (blocker-proven).

shadow_control: never emits; control price recorded on the treated intent only
